To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(1) there is an overall pattern of hesitancy in narratives, and (2) the pattern corresponds with the sections of a narrative.
pausing is not related to the type of information, but it does follow a pattern in the narrative.
the pausing phenomena are governed by the cognitive process of information organization and not by the type of information.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of pause phenomena as an indicator of the cognitive processes involved in the production of a spontaneous narrative discourse.
the role of pause phenomena in the process of organizing information in narrative discourse.
the role of pause phenomena as a means of information processing in narrative discourse.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
pausing in narratives is primarily governed by cognitive factors.
pausing in a narrative is primarily governed not by the content of the narrative but rather by the cognitive rhythm in the process of speech production.
the cognitive processes that are involved in the organization of information in narrative discourse, and the pausing strategies, seem to be independent of each other.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
pause is a device that helps the narrator organize the information in a narrative.
the cognitive processes that are involved in the production of narrative discourse are reflected by the pausing phenomena.
pausing in the narrative is not a function of information structure, but a function of the cognitive rhythm of narrative production.
The main takeaway from our work is that
pause is a complex phenomenon and that its study is not only of linguistic interest but can also be useful for cognitive psychology.
pause is not only an indicator of cognitive processing, but it also plays an important role in the process of organizing the information in the narrative.
pausing is not a mere indicator of the cognitive load, but it can be used as a tool for the organization of information in the process of narrative production.
